We’re Hiring | Product Manager at Peeko
🚀 We’re Hiring | Product Manager at Peeko Peeko is building India’s first rapid-commerce platform dedicated to babycare, making parenting faster, easier, and more convenient. We’re looking for a Product Manager to join our early-stage team and help shape what we build next. What you’ll do: - Own product problems end-to-end — from discovery to launch, measurement, and iteration - Work across consumer-facing and platform products - Turn ambiguous problems into clear product decisions - Partner with engineering, design, operations, and business teams - Use data and customer insights to form hypotheses and drive outcomes What we’re looking for: - 3–5 years of product management experience - 1+ years of B2C product experience - Strong end-to-end product shipping experience - Data-driven approach with strong analytical skills - Excellent communication and structured thinking - Startup, 0→1, marketplace, or platform experience is a plus Apply: https://lnkd.in/gDac89vv If you’re looking for difficult problems, steep learning, high ownership, and the chance to shape a product from an early stage, we’d love to hear from you. #WeAreHiring #ProductManager #ProductManagement #B2C #ProductJobs #StartupJobs #Hiring #Peeko #BangaloreJobs
